name: ERC-4626 vault accounting: share price, rounding, and donation
requires: an ERC-4626 or 4626-like vault holding user funds
convertToShares / convertToAssets or the equivalent internal maths
a deposit, mint, withdraw or redeem path an unprivileged caller can reach
questions: Does deposit round shares down and withdraw round assets down, both in the vault's favour?
Is the first depositor able to donate to inflate share price before a second depositor enters?
Does totalAssets() read a live balance (donation-sensitive) or an internal ledger?
Is there a virtual offset, dead shares, or a minimum initial deposit?
Can a redeem be front-run by a donation that makes it worth fewer assets?
Does previewRedeem match the actual redeem for the same block?
Is there a fee-on-transfer or rebasing asset where the vault credits more than it received?
Does a harvest or skim function let anyone move the value that sets share price?
false_positives: Virtual shares or dead shares already neutralise the inflation attack
totalAssets uses an internal ledger a donation cannot touch
The asset cannot be donated to the vault address (no transfer to self)
A minimum initial deposit makes the griefing cost exceed the gain
poc_must_show: the attacker's asset delta across the full sequence, measured before and after
a control deposit with no donation, showing the honest share count
the victim's realized loss, so the attacker gain has a source
no privileged role used and no capital left stranded
impact_bar: Reportable when an unprivileged sequence extracts value from other depositors, quantified. Informational for rounding that only trims dust with no victim.
